description: submission.rs process_create() lines 805-822: when client supplies a future sendAt and max_delayed_send_seconds() > 0, the code accepts any future sendAt without checking whether it exceeds now + max_delay_seconds. The comment says 'precise upper-bound check delegated to backend' but no backend method performs this check and the default backend returns 0. Trigger: backend overrides max_delayed_send_seconds() to return e.g. 3600, client sends {"sendAt": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}. Bad behavior: submission is accepted with sendAt arbitrarily far in the future, bypassing the maxDelayedSend capability limit.
title: sendAt future-send upper bound never enforced when maxDelayedSend > 0
